# waroom_service_label (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom service label. Use this data source to get details about an existing label within a service.

This is useful when you need to reference label properties (like UUID or color) that were created outside of Terraform, or when you want to use label information from one service in another part of your configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "waroom_service_label" "example" {
  service_name = "my-service"
  name         = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the label to look up.
- `service_name` (String) The name of the Waroom service containing the label.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) The color of the label in hex format without the `#` prefix.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the label was created.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the label was last updated.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the label.
